name: application-property-listing-card
title: Property Listing Card
description: Real-estate listing card with a photo area, price, address, and a bed/bath/sqft spec row, plus a real toggleable save/heart action — distinct from the generic product-card, which doesn't model property-specific specs.
useWhen: Showing a real-estate listing in a search results grid or saved-listings page.
You need the bed/bath/sqft spec row as a first-class part of the card, not generic product attributes.
Users should be able to save/unsave a listing directly from the card without navigating away.
avoidWhen: You're listing a non-real-estate product — use the generic product-card component instead.
You need a map-paired listing view — pair this card with map-listing-split instead of using it standalone.
The listing needs multiple photos in a gallery — extend the image area with a carousel.
responsiveBehavior: The card is a fixed max-width block (20rem) intended for a responsive grid; the photo area keeps a 4:3 aspect ratio at any width.
accessibility: The save button carries aria-pressed reflecting its real toggled state and an aria-label naming the specific address being saved or removed.
Saved state is conveyed by both a filled heart icon and a color change, not the fill alone.
Address text truncates with an ellipsis rather than overflowing the card at narrow widths.

variants.title: Property listing card
variants.description: Listing card for a 3bd/2ba/1,840sqft home at $685,000, shown in the saved (filled heart) state, on a light surface.
accessibility: The photo area is a gradient placeholder in this example; swap it for a real with descriptive alt text in production use.

variants.title: Property listing card (Dark)
variants.description: The same listing card, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Price, address, spec, and save-button colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
